t.E406.agn: In 2016 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern for the general population at the reported uses; the evaluation was limited to the 7 food categories for which industry provided data. JECFA has also set the ADI as 'not limited'.
t.E406.body: Agar is not absorbed intact in the gut and is fermented only to a small extent by gut bacteria.
t.E406.found.0: May be used in many foods in the EU at quantum satis (as much as needed)
t.E406.prod: Obtained from red seaweeds by hot-water extraction.
t.E406.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed. The evaluation is limited to data from 7 food categories.
t.E406.regx.2: Group I additive; may not be used in jelly mini-cups.
t.E406.summary: A plant-based gelling agent obtained from red seaweeds. Used instead of gelatine in jellies, milk puddings and desserts.
